'''Wrad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the death of Empress [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]], he joined an Imperial splinter faction led by renegade Sith Lords [[Adacin]] and [[Zanisk]]. They tasked him with killing the intruders into the base they set in the former [[Separatist stronghold]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], but Wrad was overpowered and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Wrad appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a mini-boss during the "Inferno" Uprising.
